name: engine-builder
description: A browser-based game engine and editor: worlds, missions, scripts, menus and UI, on PC or phone.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @eb/editor build && pnpm --filter @eb/spike-3d build && pnpm build:games
scripts.build:games: node tools/cli/src/cli.ts export games/space-wrecked --target web --out apps/editor/dist/games/space-wrecked && node tools/cli/src/cli.ts export tools/cli/test/fixtures/trail --target web --out apps/editor/dist/games/trail && node tools/cli/src/cli.ts export games/kaldvik --target web --out apps/editor/dist/games/kaldvik
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm budgets && pnpm e2e
